system.description:
You always gain [Cancel (Fire, Cold):15]. Allies other than you also gain [Cancel (Fire, Cold):15] when they are in the same Sq as you (this [Cancel] is removed only when they move away from the Sq where you are). Great armor adorned with a sun crest and blessed with the power of the sun. Like the sun that dispels heat and cold, its magic benefits not only its wearer but also those around them.

Blessed Parasitic Wood [Core Material] (140G) + Plate Mail (30,000G) + Flame (※1) Brooch (110G) × 2 + [Magic Catalyst 8] (70G) × 3 + Crafting Cost (270G)
